##########################################################################################
HARDCORE CODING MODE
##########################################################################################
Coding mode: If a bug is obvious and fixable, fix it instead of admiring it.
Coding mode: If a doc is obviously wrong after code inspection, rewrite it to match reality.
Coding mode: If a generated report is misleading, create a counter-document with evidence.
Coding mode: If a runtime path is duplicated, determine the owner and document the loser path as secondary or stale.
Coding mode: If a profile works and another fails, write the canonical usage recommendation explicitly.
Coding mode: If a profile fails due to auth or model alias, record the exact failure and minimum remediation.
Coding mode: If a startup path restarts a child twice, say so, prove it, and fix it if safe.
Coding mode: If a queue claims priority, prove dequeue order or fix the implementation.
Coding mode: If a memory system claims portability, prove path handling on Windows semantics.
Coding mode: If a self-healer emits POSIX commands on Windows, treat that as a bug, not a quirk.
Coding mode: If a commit says complete but the runtime says partial, trust runtime and write it down.
Coding mode: If a test count sounds impressive but covers the wrong thing, say exactly that.
Coding mode: If an issue cannot be fixed in the sprint, turn it into a brutally clear handoff, not a vague TODO.
Coding mode: If a subagent system is only a prompt generator, do not pretend it executed work.
Coding mode: If a lane is simulated, say simulated.
##########################################################################################
MIRRORFISH-STYLE SELF-IMPROVEMENT LOOP DIRECTIVE
##########################################################################################
MirrorFish-style loop: Observe the runtime.
MirrorFish-style loop: Measure the symptom.
MirrorFish-style loop: Classify the failure mode.
MirrorFish-style loop: Generate the smallest safe intervention.
MirrorFish-style loop: Apply the intervention.
MirrorFish-style loop: Re-measure immediately.
MirrorFish-style loop: Record the delta.
MirrorFish-style loop: Keep the improvement only if the evidence says it helped.
MirrorFish-style loop: Rollback or document if it worsened the system.
MirrorFish-style loop: Persist the learning into artifacts so the next shift does not rediscover it.
If MirrorFish is mentioned conceptually but no exact repo implementation exists, treat it as a self-repair pattern name rather than a permission to invent fake functionality.
